notes.title: Development Update: 2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello fellow Penal Colony Workers. 

[/b]It's been about a month since the last update so I wanted to get something out to keep ya'll up to date on how dev was going. Over the last month I've been going pretty hard trying to the narrative content in the game locked down as that's one of the last things I need to do to complete the next MVP build. [/p][p]Now I can't share much of what that looks like but here's some cool updated props for the Crane and Winch on the ship, if you re watch the trailer you'll notice these we're pretty crusty. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674112/4c541ce845126455973e77d384f83a4ed45fdf8d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674112/6512b1a9e09ab5574bafb1ca452035cb51a47dda.png"][/img]I have also been tackling some backlog work that has been troubling me for some time, that being pathfinding. [/p][p][/p][p]If you read the last update you'll know that the player controller operates like an NPC Agent under the hood and of course the enemies in the game use some kind of path finding as well. Given the nature of the game taking place on a small, cramped and highly detailed space navigation for the player, and especially the enemies has just been somewhat broken for some time now.   I set aside a week to finally put the issue to rest so I've made another devlog video to breakdown the issues visually. This one gets pretty technical around Unity quirks and the nature of A* pathfinding.  
[/p][previewyoutube="1nZQB4B0yqY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Stay Up to Date
[/b]I've been streaming development over at [url="https://twitch.tv/searchinginteractive"]twitch[/url], you can check out progress roughly twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays Melbourne time. You can also join our [url="https://discord.gg/KK9epaYvtk"]discord[/url] community here.

-Nick[/p]

notes.title: Development Update: 1
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello fellow Penal Colony Workers.[/b]   [/p][p]First off, I'd like to thank everyone who's wishlisted the game so far and shared it on socials. It was a bit of a bumpy announce but I got through it. [/p][p][/p][p]I thought I'd take the time to give you a little update on the state of production. I am not yet able to announce a release date but the game has been tracking nicely. My hope is to have it out in 2025 but I have no intention of rushing it out if it needs more work to be awesome.   [/p][p][/p][p]Mitch is back on the project, so sound design is starting to get some love. Most of the game's major features are now complete and I'm moving into a loop of testing and polishing. Whilst this feels like it's closing on the finish line I've shipped enough games to know that this phase of production can really drag out and the more time that goes in the better things will get.   [/p][p][/p][p] Here's some nice low poly Seagulls that fly over fishing zones[/p][previewyoutube="e2yIruKOTG8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]



[b]What is a first person-point and click game control like?[/b]  
For a TLDR just watch this video.[/p][previewyoutube="YakC6TLogJk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If my voice is too grating for you here's how it works :[/p][list][*][p]The entire game is played with your mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Left Mouse is used to interact with the world and navigate[/p][/*][*][p]You can freely move the camera around up to a point[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on the sides of the screen quickly turns the player [/p][/*][*][p]Items can be lifted up and readied for use with right mouse with left click activating their use[/p][/*][*][p]No i will not be adding WASD support[/p][/*][/list][p]
Anyway I'll try and get some more of these out as I work on the game more. 
If you're really determined to follow along with more updates I set up a little [url="https://discord.com/invite/KK9epaYvtk"]discord server[/url] ya'll can join.  I'm also streaming dev over at [url="https://www.twitch.tv/searchinginteractive"]twitch[/url] if you want to follow along there Tuesday and Thursday. 

-Nick [/p]
